g.text: Sensitivity to lag, outage and qualifier rules

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203d4b

g.text: Cells: pair minus local skill, in percentage points of persistence-normalized log MSE.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203d4b

g.text: All: Approved support. Clean: no qualifier on target or any required input.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203d4b

g.text: Models share dates within each cell; qualifier rules can change the denominator.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203d4b

g.text: Colour range fixed at −50 to +50 points: red (negative), white (zero), blue (positive).

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203d4b

g.text: No operational-vintage or measured sensor-cost benefit. Full cfs errors are retained separately.
